messages:
incident-bot: Paging: Canary regression detected for model 'redwood-rlf-3b' (canary pool us-west-2). Error rate on streaming/generate increased to 7.8% over baseline 0.4% in the last 5m. Severity: P2. @erica is on-call for infra.
erica: on it. ack. jumping in — will gather canary diffs + logs.
sam: reading the canary diff now. early note: responses are truncated ~55 tokens earlier than prod v2.1.3 for same prompt set. also seeing a small surge of 502s. attaching quick diff:
```
--- prod v2.1.3
+++ canary v2.2.0-rc4
- avg_length: 142
+ avg_length: 88
- timeout_502_rate: 0.4%
+ timeout_502_rate: 3.9%
- rerank_mismatch_rate: 0.2%
+ rerank_mismatch_rate: 2.1%
```

erica: thanks @sam. sam — can you paste the log excerpt from the runtime showing the request IDs for the 502s? we need timeline + customer impact.
sam: pasting stack snippet (redacted):
```
[2026-07-12T20:02:11Z] request_id=shb-9a1f gen_error="kv_cache_mismatch" model=redwood-rlf-3b canary=true
[2026-07-12T20:02:12Z] request_id=shb-9a23 http_status=502 upstream_error="stream_closed"
[2026-07-12T20:02:12Z] request_id=shb-9a24 gen_success
[2026-07-12T20:05:05Z] request_id=shb-9b11 gen_error="tokenization_failure" model=redwood-rlf-3b canary=true
```

maya: adding customer-facing impact from support-bot: small percentage (<0.5%) of paid tenants hit increased latency/timeouts in us-west. support created ticket(s): #CS-4218, #CS-4219. Notifying customers in CS tickets now.

jonas: hypothesis list (initial):
1) Model binary change introduced kv cache layout mismatch causing intermittent generation abortion. owner=@sam
2) We changed tokenizer config in build causing tokenization failures for certain unicode sequences. owner=@megan (cc @maya)
3) Runtime kernel selection edge-case with longer context evicting kv cache early under batching. owner=@jonas

megan: i've got a repro prompt that triggers tokenization_failure locally — sending small gist to the thread: https://gists.redwood/repros/abr2 (private).
erica: good. immediate mitigations:
- step 1: reduce canary traffic to 5% (from 20%) — will update rollout policy now.
- step 2: if errors persist after traffic reduction -> rollback canary to v2.1.3.
- step 3: enable extra logging on canary hosts (kv/patch metadata) for next 15m.

patrick: i changed canary config to 5% at 2026-07-12T20:12:04Z via infra-console. command: `rb rollout set redwood-rlf-3b --canary 5` — confirmed no error in API.
erica: @patrick thanks. sam — can you watch error rate for next 10m and shout if >1%?
sam: watching. current error rate after traffic cut: 2.3% (was 7.8%).

megan: quick note on tokenizer repro: failing inputs contain U+200B zero-width-space inside markdown code fences. trying local build with tokenization flag off.

jonas: status update on kernel path: added an instrumentation flag to canary runtime at 20:18Z, shipping logs to s3 bucket s3://redwood-incident-1892468100/canary-logs/ (private).
erica: good. timeline so far:
- 20:01Z: canary v2.2.0-rc4 begins rollout (20% traffic)
- 20:05Z: first error spikes observed in canary metrics (502s + shorter outputs)
- 20:08Z: incident-bot auto-alert at 20:08:20Z -> page P2
- 20:11Z: sam collects runtime excerpts showing kv_cache_mismatch
- 20:12Z: canary traffic reduced to 5% by @patrick
- 20:18Z: extra kernel instrumentation enabled by @jonas

megan: repro progress: local tokenization failure reproduces 100% with the provided prompt. suspect tokenizer change merged in v2.2.0-rc4 branch — creating PR to revert tokenizer patch.

sam: watching error rate: 20:25Z current = 0.9% (approx). still seeing isolated kv_cache_mismatch entries ~1/400 requests.
erica: decision point: given traffic reduction to 5% and error rate hovering ~1%, we can either keep canary at 5% for another 30m or fully rollback. opinions?

maya: from CS — even 0.9% is causing escalations for two mid-market tenants; recommend rollback if we see any customer-facing errors continue.

jonas: technical view: kv_cache_mismatch suggests state layout incompatibility — likely binary/serialization change. Reproduces intermittently under batching. If we can't confidently root-cause in 30m, prefer rollback.

megan: my PR to revert tokenizer also fixes some tokenization_failure but doesn't address kv_cache_mismatch. so it's a partial fix.
erica: leaning rollback. target: rollback canary to v2.1.3 and stop further rollouts of rc4.

sam: rolling back: `rb rollback redwood-rlf-3b --to v2.1.3 --scope canary` issued at 2026-07-12T20:33:02Z. infra messages: deploy-bot: rollback started -> 3 canary hosts reverting.

incident-bot: Rollback event: canary pool redwood-rlf-3b -> v2.1.3 requested by sam. status: in-progress.

patrick: rollback completed at 2026-07-12T20:36:40Z on all canary hosts. post-rollback metrics: error rate dropped to baseline 0.3% in us-west.

maya: CS update: created customer notes for impacted tenants and sent follow-up soon after rollback. #CS-4218 and #CS-4219 updated.

erica: follow-up action items (owners):
- A1: full RCA doc: combine diffs, logs, timeline, and hypothesis verification. owner=@sam (due 2026-07-13 18:00Z)
- A2: block rc4 from future rollouts until gated tests added. owner=@jonas (due 2026-07-13 12:00Z)
- A3: revert tokenizer change or add robust tokenization tests for U+200B sequences. owner=@megan (PR in progress)
- A4: add kv_cache integrity check to canary runtime to detect layout mismatch earlier. owner=@patrick (due 2026-07-14)
- A5: support/CS outreach & postmortem customer summary. owner=@maya (due 2026-07-13)

sam: note for RCA — include sample request_ids: shb-9a1f, shb-9a23, shb-9b11. logs archived to s3://redwood-incident-1892468100/archive.tar.gz

erica: closing on-call handoff: i'll do a final check at 21:00Z and then hand to daytime oncall. leave this thread open for RCA coordination. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Notifying CS lead: @maya. Tickets flagged for priority follow-up.

megan: quick follow: i'm going to run extended fuzz of tokenizer for unicode edgecases — will post results here.

jonas: i'll scope an automated test to validate kv cache serialization across minor builds, propose gating in CI.

erica: thanks everyone. thread will be referenced in formal incident doc. if anyone finds additional customer impact after 21:00Z ping me directly. :phone:

patrick: final note: pinned rollout config `prevent_unpinned_canaries = true` has been set for this model group to avoid accidental future canary pushes without explicit pin.

megan: closing note: PR to revert tokenizer is ready for review, tagging @erica and @jonas.

erica: last check 20:59Z — system stable. closing thread for active paging. continuing RCA in parallel. :lock:
